key_bullish_phrases: consumer spending remained resilient, and cross-border travel continues to recover. With this backdrop, we delivered strong revenue and earnings growth through the focused execution of our strategy.
Third quarter net revenues were up 23% and adjusted operating income up 27%, both versus a year ago on a non-GAAP currency-neutral basis
Cross-border travel in the third quarter has reached 124% of 2019 levels
key_bearish_phrases: the macroeconomic and geopolitical environment remains uncertain. Inflationary pressures have remained elevated and central banks are continuing to take aggressive steps to bring inflation in line.
Tensions remain high with the war in Ukraine and the supply of natural gas to Europe is a concern.
Should the market outlook weaken, we are prepared to act quickly to modulate our expenses.
